title: Expunction vs. Non-Disclosure
full_vo: Two ways to clean up a Texas record — and they're not the same. [pause] **Expunction** wipes the arrest from the public databases like it never happened — usually for dismissals, acquittals, certain deferred outcomes. (beat) **Non-disclosure** *seals* it from the public but keeps it visible to law enforcement. [pause] Expunction is the bigger win; non-disclosure is the fallback. Which one you qualify for depends on your facts — and that's a five-minute conversation.
